title: Mushroom Coloring Pages, 20 Bold and Easy Woodland Coloring Pages for Kids & Adults, Cozy Cottagecore Frog Fox Snail Printable pdf
description:
Twenty cozy mushroom and woodland coloring pages with thick, bold outlines and big, easy spaces to fill. Print them tonight and color with your kids, your class, or on your own with a cup of tea: a happy frog on a spotted toadstool, a fox asleep in the ferns, a snail beside tall mushrooms, a little mushroom cottage, a mushroom teapot and fifteen more.

Bold and easy means thick outlines (about 2 mm when printed), every space closed and big enough for crayons, colored pencils and markers, and no tiny fiddly details. Great for little hands, and relaxing for grown-ups who want a calm, low-detail page. There is no text on the pages and each design has its own page. No holidays or seasons on the pages, so they work all year.

THE 20 PAGES
1 Mushroom cottage · 2 Frog on a toadstool · 3 Snail and mushrooms · 4 Fox in the ferns · 5 Hedgehog and mushrooms · 6 Moth and moon · 7 Mushrooms on a log · 8 Owl and toadstools · 9 Bunny under a mushroom · 10 Toadstool trio · 11 Foraging basket · 12 Ladybugs on a toadstool · 13 Mouse under a toadstool · 14 Fawn in the glade · 15 Squirrel on a mushroom · 16 Mushroom meadow · 17 Wren on a mushroom · 18 Bear cub forager · 19 Mushroom jar · 20 Mushroom teapot

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 20 coloring pages, one design per page
• 2 pdf files: US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) and A4, 20 pages each
• The art is the same size on both papers, inside a rounded frame with a safe white margin, so home printers won't cut it off

HOW TO USE
• Print at 100% (actual size) on plain paper for crayons and pencils, or on card stock for markers and paint
• Print one page or all 20, as many times as you like
• Lovely for quiet time, rainy days, classroom nature units, birthday parties, library and homeschool groups and cozy nights in

GOOD TO KNOW
• The colored examples in the photos are there to give you ideas; the files are black and white line art
• Colors on screen and paper vary with your printer

LICENSE
Personal use: print as many copies as you like for your own home, family and classroom. Please don't share, resell or redistribute the files or printed pages.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co. Printing and paper are not included.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
